tasks.description: In `orchestrator/container_spawner.py:spawn_agent_container()`, change line 308 guard from `if repo_volumes and repos:` to `if repos:` — repo_volumes is always overwritten by gateway result
tasks.acceptance_criteria: spawn_agent_container with repos but no repo_volumes triggers gateway.create_worktrees and mounts result

tasks.description: Add test verifying spawn_agent_container creates worktrees when repos is provided but repo_volumes is None

pr.title: Fix restart losing worktrees by gating on repos not repo_volumes
pr.description:
restart_phase and restart_agent call spawn_agent_container without
repo_volumes, causing per-agent worktree creation to be skipped.
Change the guard from `if repo_volumes and repos` to `if repos`.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: new test_spawn_creates_worktree_without_repo_volumes
- Automated: existing test suite (make test)
- Manual: run restart_phase on a pipeline and verify the new container mounts the existing worktree
